name: age-of-majority
description: Is this person a minor here? The age of majority and the digital-consent age (GDPR Art. 8, COPPA and equivalents) by jurisdiction — US states, Canadian provinces, Australian states, the EU/EEA, the UK and more — each with its statute, a link, a confidence level and effective-dated changes. Leap-day births handled per statute. Unknown places answer null, never a guessed 18. Pure functions, zero dependencies.
author: Drew Thomas <drew@drewthomasbuilds.com> (https://drewthomasbuilds.com)
